'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals Chris W. LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris W.]] at [[2011 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
